purpose: Verify complete basis workflow BW-BA-01 execution where a user submits a secure archival request and the respective HoD rejects it
preconditions: User is authenticated; respective HoD for the user's department is authenticated; BADMS is operational
action_or_input: User submits a valid secure archival request with required metadata; respective HoD evaluates the request and selects Reject with justification
expected_result: Request transitions from Not Submitted to Submitted upon submission, and then from Submitted to Rejected upon HoD decision; requester receives rejection notification

purpose: Verify that valid submission of a secure archival request transitions state from Not Submitted to Submitted and routes to the requester's HoD (Transition 1)
preconditions: User is authenticated; storage quota is sufficient; valid archival metadata provided
action_or_input: User submits the secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS validates request data and quota, creates request in Submitted state, and routes it to the requester's HoD

purpose: Verify that the respective HoD's rejection decision transitions the request from Submitted to Rejected (Transition 2)
preconditions: A secure archival request exists in Submitted state under the HoD's department
action_or_input: Respective HoD records a Reject decision for the request
expected_result: Request status transitions to Rejected; decision is recorded in audit logs and requester is notified; workflow terminates

purpose: Verify department-scope enforcement where an HoD from a different department cannot reject the request
preconditions: A secure archival request in Submitted state belongs to Department A; HoD from Department B is authenticated
action_or_input: HoD from Department B attempts to reject the request belonging to Department A
expected_result: BADMS rejects the action due to departmental boundary; request remains in Submitted state

purpose: Verify that HoD rejection cannot be performed on a request that is not in Submitted state
preconditions: Archival request is in Not Submitted or already in Rejected state
action_or_input: HoD attempts to record a rejection on the request
expected_result: BADMS denies the transition; request status remains unchanged

purpose: Verify complete basis workflow BW-BA-02 execution where user submits, HoD approves, and SysAdmin assigns a non-Sensitive authoritative classification
preconditions: Authenticated accounts for User, respective HoD, and SysAdmin exist; BADMS is operational
action_or_input: User submits archival request; respective HoD approves request; SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification Routine
expected_result: Request transitions Not Submitted -> Submitted -> HoD Approved -> Classified Non-Sensitive / Policy Applied; retention policy is applied and workflow terminates

purpose: Verify that respective HoD approval transitions request from Submitted to HoD Approved and routes it to SysAdmin (Transition 2)
preconditions: Secure archival request exists in Submitted state under the HoD's department
action_or_input: Respective HoD records an Approve decision
expected_result: Request transitions to HoD Approved and is routed to SysAdmin for authoritative classification

purpose: Verify that SysAdmin assigning a non-Sensitive classification (Routine, Archival, or Critical) transitions request to Classified Non-Sensitive / Policy Applied (Transition 3)
preconditions: Request is in HoD Approved state; SysAdmin is authenticated
action_or_input: SysAdmin selects authoritative classification Archival (Classification != Sensitive)
expected_result: Request status transitions to Classified Non-Sensitive / Policy Applied; institute retention rules apply without routing to IT Security

purpose: Verify that a non-SysAdmin actor cannot assign authoritative classification to an approved archival request
preconditions: Request is in HoD Approved state; User or HoD is authenticated
action_or_input: User or HoD attempts to execute BA-UC-004 to classify data
expected_result: BADMS denies the operation with authorization error; request status remains HoD Approved

purpose: Verify that SysAdmin classification cannot be performed prior to HoD approval
preconditions: Request is in Submitted state awaiting HoD decision
action_or_input: SysAdmin attempts to assign authoritative classification to the request
expected_result: BADMS denies the classification transition; request remains in Submitted state

purpose: Verify complete basis workflow BW-BA-03 execution through submission, HoD approval, SysAdmin Sensitive classification, and IT Security AES-256 encryption
preconditions: Authenticated accounts exist for User, respective HoD, SysAdmin, and IT Security Team
action_or_input: User submits request; HoD approves; SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification Sensitive; IT Security Team configures encryption and creates archive
expected_result: Request transitions Not Submitted -> Submitted -> HoD Approved -> Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security -> Sensitive Archive Encrypted; archive is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and in transit

purpose: Verify that SysAdmin assigning authoritative classification Sensitive transitions request to Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security (Transition 3)
preconditions: Request is in HoD Approved state; SysAdmin is authenticated
action_or_input: SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification Sensitive
expected_result: Request status transitions to Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security and is routed to IT Security Team

purpose: Verify that successful encryption configuration by IT Security Team transitions request to Sensitive Archive Encrypted (Transition 4)
preconditions: Request is in Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security state; IT Security Team is authenticated

expected_result: BADMS creates AES-256 encrypted archive; request status transitions to Sensitive Archive Encrypted

purpose: Verify that a non-IT Security actor cannot configure encryption on sensitive archival requests
preconditions: Request is in Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security state; SysAdmin or regular User is authenticated
action_or_input: SysAdmin or User attempts to execute BA-UC-005 to configure encryption
expected_result: BADMS denies authorization; request status remains Classified Sensitive / Routed to IT Security

purpose: Verify that encryption configuration cannot be triggered for requests not classified as Sensitive
preconditions: Request is in Classified Non-Sensitive / Policy Applied state
action_or_input: IT Security Team attempts to execute BA-UC-005 on the non-sensitive request
expected_result: BADMS rejects the action; request status remains unchanged

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-BA-01 decision branching at HoD review between Reject and Approve paths

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-BA-01 decision branching at SysAdmin classification between Non-Sensitive and Sensitive paths

purpose: Verify CW-BA-01 end-to-end composite execution along the approved Sensitive path through all four participating roles
